description: Fault-based probabilistic seismic hazard analysis in regions with low strain rates and a thick seismogenic layer: a case study from Malawi. Supplementary Files is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. First release of supplementary files for running probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) MATLAB codes for Malawi as uploaded to Github at: PSHA Includes both input files for performing PSHA and output ground motions for plotting PSHA results. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are seismic hazard, earthquake, geology, natural hazards, risk. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
